hypothesis: Curiosity hook + audio reveal maximizes CTR. Listeners must hear the quality difference.

creative.name: Audio-First: Curiosity + Reveal
creative.headline: This voicemail got a 40% callback rate.
creative.primary_text: Play this voicemail. Go ahead, hit play. ... That's not a person. That's AgentRVM. AI voicemails that sound so real, sellers call back thinking it's their neighbor. 10,000 voicemails. Zero phone calls. Your competitors are already using this.
creative.description: Hear the AI voicemail that closes deals.

hook.text: This voicemail got a 40% callback rate.

reveal.text: That was AI. Not a person.

notes: Audio is the #1 differentiator. Wholesalers respond to: 1) proof (40% callback rate), 2) hearing it works, 3) FOMO (competitors already using). This ad hits all three.
